definitions.short: Caleb , the name of three Israelites
definitions.full: H3612. Kaleb כָּלֵב proper name, masculine (Nabataean proper name כלבא Eut (Nö) p. 55 . כלבו Vog Nab. 6 ; compare also We Skizzen u. Vorarbeiten iii. 217 ; on כָּלֵב = dog-clan , see RS K 17, 190 f., 219, 254 ); — son of יְפֻנֶּה ( ᵐ5 Ξαλεβ ; compare Lag BN 78 ), called הַקְּנִזִּי (see קְנַז ) in J E, Num 32:12 ; Josh 14:6 , 14 , compare 15:17 = Judg 1:13 ; 3:9 (where קְנַז is brother of ׳כ ), also 1Chr 4:15 ; treated as full Judahite only in P Num 13:6 (see GFM Ju p. 30 f. ) the one of the spies who (with Joshua) reported well of Canaan 14:6 , 24 , 30 , 38 ; also 26:65 ; 34:19 ; Deut 1:36 ; Josh 14:13 ; 15:13-14 , 16 , 18 ; 21:12 (P = 1Chr 6:41 ) Judg 1:12 , 14 , 15 , 20 (|| with Joshua 15); = clan of Caleb 1Sam 30:14 (distinguished from Judah). Caleb is called בֶּןחֶֿצְרוֺן 1Chr 2:18 , compare 2:19 ; 2:42 ; 2:46 ; 2:48 ; 2:49 ; 2:50 = כְּלוּבָ֑י 2:9 ; אֶפְרָתָה בְּכָלֵב 2:24 , read perh כ ׳בָּא , so ᵑ9 ᵐ5 , compare Kau AT (see אֶפְרָתָה above)
definitions.rootNote: perhaps a form of 3611 , or else from the same root in the sense of forcible;
